objectives.summary: The project aims to create a fully featured open-source Document Translations Portal that connects translators with clients, eliminating high costs associated with traditional translation agencies. It seeks to provide essential translation services to individuals who cannot afford conventional services, ensuring accessibility without geographic or cultural restrictions.
key_points: The portal is designed to be a fully featured open-source Document Translations Portal.
The project aims to assist translators and individuals needing essential translation services who cannot afford to be taken advantage of by large translation agencies.
Clients can post their projects for free on the portal, allowing for cost-effective translation services.
The platform will connect translators and clients, benefiting both sides by reducing costs and increasing accessibility.
The project funding goal was $4,942, but the funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by February 22, 2014.
The only risk anticipated is not being able to secure enough funding within a month.
